query:
SELECT
                id,
                data,
                EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM expires_at)::BIGINT AS "expires_at!",
                EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM created_at)::BIGINT AS "created_at!",
                EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM updated_at)::BIGINT AS "updated_at!"
            FROM
                sessions
            WHERE
                id = $1 AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
